pos.personaBrief: Spielverlagerung gives 54.3% possession and a more controlled style than Conte, but the 4-4-2 block, defending for lengthy periods and a 0-0/1-0 plan vs Bayern show possession was a tool, not a creed.

pro.personaBrief: Juve built out short from deep even when pressed (Spielverlagerung) with Pirlo/Pjanic as risk-taking passers, but also hit long balls to Tevez and Morata vs Dortmund and used patient sideways circulation.

est.personaBrief: Defensive roles were clearly defined (back five, narrow 4-4-2), but attackers drifted: Dybala withdrew, wingers dropped between the lines, Mandzukic moved to the left, and shapes changed by opponent.

lar.personaBrief: Width came from wing-backs and full-backs (Alex Sandro, Alves overlaps) and crosses to Mandzukic, while the favourite 4-3-1-2 diamond and the central playmakers put the best players inside.

blo.personaBrief: The common defensive shape was a deep, narrow 4-4-2 or 5-4-1 with intermittent pressing in waves, the front two forcing play wide and the team recovering shape rather than counter-pressing.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal marking with smaller man-orientations (Spielverlagerung), a man-oriented zonal system; no dedicated shadowing of stars, and a corner complaint about positional movement.

pla.personaBrief: Allegri changed the inherited 3-5-2 to a diamond, 4-2-3-1 and 4-3-3 depending on opponent and personnel, adjusting mid-match, a coach without dogmas.

res.personaBrief: Five Scudetti, patience and control over tempo, content to frustrate opponents and defend for long periods, relying on defence for 0-0 or 1-0 away vs Bayern.

sis.personaBrief: Allegri says he is not a theorist and adapts to the players; everyone works (Mandzukic covering the flank, Tevez work rate), but he has no rigid system and stars like Dybala and Higuain got licence in attack.

jog.personaBrief: A mix of the BBC's aerial and duel strength, Mandzukic and Khedira physicality with technical playmakers such as Pirlo, Pjanic and Dybala who were given a place.

bas.personaBrief: Squad built on proven signings (usato garantito, Khedira free, Mandzukic) and the veteran BBC; prudence over academy kids, and Rugani was never liked.

lid.personaBrief: Allegri manages people and trust (Tevez praised) but applied authority, excluding Bonucci vs Porto, with some dressing room grumbling over favourites.
